title: Rose Quartz (Pink Quartz)
description: 🪨 makes nether quartz (a very light) pink!
body:
this resource pack makes nether quartz pink because its wayyyyyyy cuter! (mojang get to it!)

this doesn't rename quartz itself btw, it's still called nether quartz in game.
the color of the tooltip text that shows u what trim u're using is unchanged cuz ummm idon think a resource pack can change dat
